note: The Credit Reporting Act (Cap. 84:01), section 17, in the Ministry of Legal Affairs' laws of Guyana: a bureau keeps each consumer's file seven years after the credit's termination or settlement. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: Laws of Guyana, Credit Reporting Act, Chapter 84:01 (Ministry of Legal Affairs)
sources.said: for a period of seven years after the date of termination or settlement of the credit extended by the credit provider or lender.
